c4e9fc1dbc.why: Fold the three temporary loads into ymm1, ymm3, and ymm5 into their consuming unpack instructions, delaying the rdx increment until those reads finish. The unpack results, subsequent arithmetic, destination average, stores, and final flags remain identical.

4abd26513c.why: The arbitrary unpack and coefficient registers require the existing SSE2 widening, products, sums, saturation, and packing, while all final temporaries and pointer and flag results must be preserved.

083a8559c5.why: The SSE2 filter has no redundant arithmetic for arbitrary input registers, and folding the final qword load into PAVGB would widen the memory access and lose the required xmm1 value.

5a2765210f.why: The qword loads and byte interleaves feed necessary saturated dot products and rounded scaling, and folding those loads into legacy unpack memory operands would widen accesses and impose alignment requirements.

696176e79d.why: The filter already uses SSSE3 dot products and rounded multiplication, while the qword input and destination loads cannot be folded into wider legacy SIMD operands without changing memory accesses or required register results.

8c61a2b734.why: Both unpack halves and their intermediate results are needed, and folding the unaligned source loads into legacy SSE unpack operands would introduce alignment requirements absent from MOVDQU.

9e07fb49dc.why: The required unpack halves, arithmetic results, and destination average leave no removable operation, and legacy SSE unpack memory operands cannot safely replace the unaligned MOVDQU source loads.
